items.title: Puka Nacua: Has expected return date of mid-December
items.text:
Nacua (knee/toe) has an expected return date of "mid-December," Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Drake Maye: Won't return Sunday
items.text:
Maye (ankle) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Lions, Doug Kyed of the Boston Herald reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Drake Maye: Injures ankle, questionable to return
items.text:
Maye is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Lions in Munich after sustaining an ankle injury in the first quarter.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Patrick Mahomes: Team sought more opinions on QB's elbow
items.text:
In addition to the Chiefs team doctors reviewing Mahomes' (throwing) elbow scans, the team sought further feedback from renowned doctors from the Kansas City Royals and Texas Rangers, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: A.J. Brown: Active for Sunday's game versus Detroit
items.text:
